ticket.title: storypole error taxonomy has no neutral variant, so plan-step errors render with a misleading prefix
ticket.description: FIXED AND VERIFIED 2026-11-10 (storypole 8ec0f5d). storypole error taxonomy now has a neutral variant, StorypoleError::Rejected, which renders its message verbatim; the two plan-step refusals use it instead of InvalidIdentifier. The ticket had no description, so the symptom was reconstructed from the title and confirmed in code: plan_ops.rs raised InvalidIdentifier for a missing step and for a task with no plan, producing Invalid task identifier: no plan step 99 on ... - a correct message under a prefix that contradicts it. Proven live rather than only in tests: storypole plan step SP-53 99 now answers exactly Error: task SP-53 has no attached plan, with no misleading prefix. Two tests assert the rendered message, because the defect was in what a reader sees. nextest -p storypole-core 193/193.
